description: FINRA Reg SHO daily short-sale volume for one symbol on one trading day, summed across every consolidated-NMS reporting facility (Nasdaq TRF Carteret, NYSE TRF, Nasdaq TRF Chicago) so the total matches FINRA's consolidated CNMS figure. Returns short_volume, short_exempt_volume, total_volume, short_ratio (short / total), and the per-facility breakdown. Publishing lag is T+1 or better; omit `date` for the most recent published day. Zero-rated: FINRA's terms forbid charging for this data, so the call costs 0 credits.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. Defaults to the most recent published trading day.

name: short_volume_daily
